name: Riot Games API
tagline: Official competitive game data for League of Legends, Valorant, TFT, and more
description: Official Riot Games API for League of Legends, VALORANT, TFT, LoR, and more: match history, player stats, ranked ladders, live game data, account identity via regional routing. Free keys from the developer portal with rate limits; production needs approval.

auth.details: Development keys auto-issue and deactivate every 24h; personal keys require product registration (private use); production keys need app approval. Auth via X-Riot-Token header or api_key query. VALORANT has separate product/approval restrictions.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Development keys: free, deactivate every 24h, low limits. Personal keys: free after product registration for private use. Production keys: free after approval for public apps, higher limits. All via developer.riotgames.com.

rate_limits: Personal keys: 20 req/s and 100 req/2min per region. Production starting limits: 500 req/10s and 30,000 req/10min per region; method/service limits may also apply (see developer portal).
use_cases: look up a League of Legends summoner by name or PUUID
fetch match history and match details for a player
get ranked ladder standings for a queue
retrieve VALORANT player match stats by region
get Teamfight Tactics (TFT) ranked leaderboard data
resolve Riot account identity across games via account-v1
